title: What each constituency signs
excerpt: I mapped 734 UK Parliament petitions across all 650 constituencies. Every map is clustered, local causes are far more lopsided than other topics, and seats differ along two signature personalities that barely change over time.
seo_description: Where in the UK do people sign which Parliament petitions? 734 petitions mapped across all 650 constituencies.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'What each constituency signs' beside a hexagon map of the 650 UK constituencies shaded from blue to red by their first signature personality.
